The Early Career team at Figma is shaping the future by finding and nurturing the next generation of talent - Figma's future leaders!

You'll play a key role on our Early Career Recruiting team, with end-to-end ownership of recruiting across (but not limited to) Software Engineering, Data Science & Data Engineering - from sourcing strategy and pipeline development to candidate experience and offer.

You'll partner cross-functionally with hiring managers, program partners, and the broader Early Career Recruiting team to build and scale how Figma hires the next generation of talent.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

· Manage full-cycle recruiting processes for interns and full-time candidates (including PhD), ensuring a smooth, uniform, and top-notch candidate experience

· Construct creative and inclusive hiring strategies to engage, source, evaluate, and hire top early career talent across Figma

· Partner closely with leaders and hiring managers across technical and non-technical pipelines

· Drive candidate engagement through in-person and virtual events, partnering with stakeholders to create compelling experiences that convert top talent

· Create strong and trusting relationships with all cross-functional teams including but not limited to Data Science, Engineering, and People teams (Workplace, Onboarding, BEI, Business Partners)

s.t:
· 4+ years of experience in full-cycle early career recruiting and programs, with a deep understanding of the early career lifecycle including PhD pipelines

· A track record for creating inclusive practices across all early career functions

· Proven track record of managing competing priorities with consistent follow-through across recruiting cycles

· Demonstrated experience owning full-cycle recruiting across both technical and non-technical roles, from pipeline build to close

· Experience driving candidate engagement through in-person and virtual recruiting events, from planning through execution

· Collaborate with hiring managers across technical and non-technical pipelines to align on role requirements, candidate profiles, and hiring decisions

· The ability to travel for campus, regional, and Figma hub events

We're excited to grow our Early Career team with a unique opportunity! Figma's AI and research strategy is a critical company priority, and attracting exceptional research talent is central to how we deliver on it.

We're looking for an experienced PhD Recruiter to own hiring strategy across Engineering and evolve our existing program into a scalable, year-round function. In this role, you'll lead end-to-end recruiting, shape hiring strategy with engineering leaders, and drive Figma's presence at top research conferences.

You'll be a trusted strategic partner with a genuine seat at the table, helping define how Figma competes for some of the most sought-after AI and research talent in the world.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

· Manage the full-cycle recruiting process for intern and full-time PhD roles across Engineering including but not limited to Data, AI, Graphics, and Security

· Partner with Eng VPs and Directors to own PhD hiring strategy, shaping how Figma approaches and scales research talent across the org

· Lead Figma's presence at research conferences like NeurIPS, aligning stakeholders and running on-site logistics from booth setup to interviewer prep

· Own the publication process for PhD roles, partnering with hiring teams, legal, and senior leadership

· Mentor recruiters on the team supporting PhD efforts, growing the bench as the function scales

· Lead the strategic direction of the PhD recruiting function, building processes from scratch and closing offers with a rare, highly sought-after pool of research talent

s.h: We'd love to hear from you if you have
s.t:
· 6+ years of full-lifecycle technical recruiting experience in a high-growth organization, including 3+ years focused on PhD/research hiring

· A track record of hiring PhD candidates through self-sourced pipelines, including conferences, research labs, and professor connections

· Experience building and running PhD programs

· Demonstrated success partnering with senior engineering leaders and executives on high-priority, high-touch candidate and offer scenarios

· Willingness to travel internationally to conferences, universities, and labs, roughly 3-4 trips per year

Join us in building the future of finance.
Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.
As an Executive Sourcer, you play a critical role in identifying and engaging top-tier executive talent across functions. You will identify, engage, and build relationships with senior-level and executive talent across a range of business functions.

You’ll partner closely with executive recruiters and leadership stakeholders to define talent profiles, conduct market research, and develop targeted sourcing strategies for leadership hiring initiatives.

You will play a key role in shaping executive pipelines, delivering talent insights, and helping drive long-term succession and organizational planning efforts. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact searches while contributing to the evolution of executive sourcing practices and research capabilities across Robinhood!
This role is based in our Chicago, IL, Menlo Park, CA, and New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.
At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

Build and maintain executive-level candidate pipelines through market mapping, research, and targeted outreach across all functions
Identify and engage passive executive talent using sourcing strategies, competitive intelligence, and relationship-building approaches
Partner with executive recruiters and hiring leaders to align on leadership profiles, succession priorities, and long-term pipeline planning
Track candidate activity and maintain organized workflows using tools such as Greenhouse, Gem, and executive research platforms
Analyze sourcing data, outreach effectiveness, and talent market trends to refine engagement strategies and improve pipeline quality

4+ years of experience in executive search, advising clients on talent and hiring, and managing the search process.
Experience identifying and engaging passive candidates from top industry players through research, outreach, and sourcing tools
Ability to partner with recruiters and senior stakeholders to translate business priorities into targeted sourcing and research strategies
Experience using sourcing tools (such as Gem, LinkedIn Recruiter, or similar platforms) and applicant tracking systems
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple executive searches and maintain accurate pipeline tracking
Comfort using AI tools to support sourcing, research, and outreach, with an interest in testing new tools to improve efficiency

Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Hinge is the dating app designed to be deleted

In today's digital world, finding genuine relationships is tougher than ever. At Hinge, we’re on a mission to inspire intimate connection to create a less lonely world. We’re obsessed with understanding our users’ behaviors to help them find love, and our success is defined by one simple metric– setting up great dates. With millions of users across the globe, we’ve become the most trusted way to find a relationship, for all.

At Hinge, building meaningful connections starts with the people we bring onto our team. As a Lead Talent Acquisition Partner, you'll lead hiring across our Business and Product organizations, partnering closely with senior leaders as a trusted talent advisor. You'll help shape hiring decisions by providing market insights, talent intelligence, and data-driven recommendations that enable thoughtful, long-term growth.
This is a highly visible, high-impact role for a recruiter who thinks beyond individual requisitions. You'll influence talent strategy, anticipate hiring needs before they emerge, and bring a strong point of view on how to attract, assess, and hire exceptional talent. Success in this role requires a blend of strategic thinking, business acumen, and the ability to build credibility with stakeholders at every level of the organization.

Talent Strategy & Executive Partnership
Serve as a trusted talent advisor to senior leaders across Product and Business functions, influencing hiring strategies that align with organizational priorities and long-term workforce plans.
Translate market intelligence, competitive talent insights, and hiring data into actionable recommendations that help leaders make informed talent decisions.
Partner with leaders to anticipate future talent needs, assess organizational gaps, and develop proactive hiring plans before openings arise.
Challenge assumptions, provide thoughtful perspective on talent availability and market dynamics, and influence hiring decisions through data and expertise.
Recruiting Excellence & Process Leadership
Lead end-to-end hiring for critical and high-impact roles, ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring teams.
Continuously evaluate and improve interview frameworks, assessment methodologies, and hiring processes to increase quality, consistency, and efficiency.
Drive calibration across interview teams, establish best practices for evaluation, and elevate hiring rigor through structured interviewing and competency-based assessments.
Leverage AI-enabled recruiting tools and automation to improve recruiter productivity, streamline workflows, and enhance decision-making.
Analyze recruiting metrics and funnel health to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and recommend improvements that drive stronger hiring outcomes.
Market Intelligence & Talent Mapping
Develop deep expertise across key talent markets, maintaining a strong understanding of competitive landscapes, emerging skill sets, compensation trends, and organizational structures.
Conduct talent mapping and succession-oriented research to help leaders understand available talent pools and long-term hiring opportunities.
Build and execute sophisticated sourcing strategies that leverage multiple channels, industry networks, referrals, events, and direct outreach to engage top talent.
Regularly brief leaders on market conditions, talent availability, and competitive hiring activity to inform workforce planning decisions.
Inclusive Hiring & Talent Attraction
Embed inclusive hiring practices throughout the recruiting lifecycle, ensuring interview processes, candidate evaluations, and hiring decisions are structured, equitable, and focused on identifying the strongest talent.
Partner with talent communities, professional organizations, and strategic sourcing channels to expand access to underrepresented talent and strengthen pipeline diversity.
Champion a thoughtful and consistent candidate experience that reflects Hinge's values and employer brand.
Talent Brand & Candidate Experience
Act as an ambassador for Hinge, articulating our mission, culture, and value proposition in a compelling and authentic way.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen employer branding initiatives and attract exceptional talent.
Build meaningful relationships with candidates, creating a high-touch experience that fosters engagement throughout the hiring process.
Offer Strategy & Stakeholder Management
Guide leaders through complex hiring decisions, balancing candidate experience, business priorities, market realities, and internal equity considerations.
Develop competitive offer strategies informed by compensation benchmarks, internal parity, and candidate motivations.
Build strong partnerships across Talent Acquisition, People, Compensation, and business leadership teams to ensure alignment throughout the hiring process.
Influence without authority, navigate ambiguity, and drive alignment among diverse stakeholders to achieve hiring goals.

8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including significant experience supporting Product, Business, or technical organizations in high-growth environments.
Demonstrated success partnering with senior leaders and influencing hiring decisions through data, market expertise, and strategic consultation.
Proven ability to develop and execute talent strategies for complex or business-critical hiring initiatives.
Strong sourcing and talent mapping capabilities, with experience identifying and engaging passive talent across competitive markets.
Expertise in structured interviewing, assessment design, hiring process optimization, and recruiter enablement.
Experience leveraging recruiting analytics to identify trends, solve problems, and drive continuous improvement.
Strong business acumen with the ability to connect talent decisions to organizational objectives.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility and trust across all levels of an organization.
Experience utilizing modern recruiting technologies, sourcing platforms, and AI-enabled recruiting tools.
Familiarity with ATS platforms such as Greenhouse, Lever, or Workday.

Experience recruiting within consumer technology, marketplace, mobile-first, or high-growth technology companies.
Experience influencing hiring strategy across multiple business functions and seniority levels.
Knowledge of New York compensation practices and geographic pay considerations.

Know where you belong!

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.

When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL). We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.

At Match Group, genuine connection is everything — and that starts with the people we hire. As a Senior Recruiter, you’ll own full-cycle recruiting across a broad range of corporate functions, with a particular focus on Trust & Safety hiring. This is a generalist role built for someone who thrives in variety: one week you’re closing a senior Finance leader, the next you’re building a pipeline for a nuanced Trust & Safety policy role that requires careful screening and subject matter fluency.

You’ll operate as a true talent partner — bringing market insight, strategic thinking, and a strong candidate experience to every search. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for a recruiter who takes pride in doing the work well, regardless of the function.

This role is based out of our Dallas office.

How you will make an impact
Full-Cycle Recruitment
Own end-to-end recruiting across Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing, Communications, and Trust & Safety. Leverage AI-enabled tools to drive efficiency, continuously refine interview rubrics and scorecards, and track key metrics including time-to-fill, pass-through rates, and offer acceptance.
Trust & Safety Recruiting
Develop fluency in Trust & Safety functions — content moderation, policy, investigations, and platform integrity — to screen and assess candidates with confidence. Partner with T&S leaders to build targeted pipelines and apply thoughtful screening practices for roles requiring high judgment and discretion.
Sourcing & Pipeline Development
Design and execute multi-channel sourcing strategies across job boards, LinkedIn, niche communities, and direct outreach. Leverage AI-enabled tools and predictive analytics to engage passive candidates and stay ahead of market trends.
Inclusive Hiring & Talent Attraction
Embed equitable, structured hiring practices throughout the recruiting lifecycle. Partner with talent communities and strategic sourcing channels to expand access to underrepresented talent and champion a consistent, values-driven candidate experience.
Talent Brand & Candidate Experience
Serve as a compelling ambassador for Match Group — articulating our mission, culture, and value proposition authentically. Build high-touch candidate relationships and partner cross-functionally to strengthen employer branding initiatives.
Stakeholder & Offer Management
Act as a trusted talent partner to corporate and operational leaders — translating market data into actionable hiring recommendations and navigating complex role definitions with confidence. Provide offer guidance grounded in compensation benchmarking, internal equity, and candidate expectations.

5+ years of full-cycle corporate recruiting experience, ideally in tech, consumer, or high-growth companies, with experience recruiting across multiple functions and seniority levels simultaneously
Demonstrated ability to recruit across a variety of corporate functions with speed and quality, including some exposure to Trust & Safety, policy, compliance, or operations recruiting and familiarity with the unique sensitivities and screening considerations involved
Strong command of LinkedIn Recruiter, AI talent platforms, and Boolean search techniques
Comfort using recruiting metrics to drive decisions and present pipeline insights to leadership
Hands-on experience building interview frameworks, scorecards, and assessment rubrics
ATS expertise with Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, or a comparable platform
Excellent stakeholder management skills with high emotional intelligence and the ability to build trust quickly
Knowledge of Dallas/DFW compensation structures and geographic pay considerations

Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.
Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era.

From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

Our Business Recruiting team is growing, and we're looking for someone who is deeply curious, highly agile, and energized by the work of building talent-dense teams. You'll own searches for our early career roles across the business, partnering closely with hiring managers to identify, attract, and assess candidates. You'll think creatively about how to find talent, experiment with new sourcing and evaluation approaches, and use AI and modern tools to work smarter and move faster.
Traditional recruiting experience isn’t required. We welcome candidates from sales, operations, customer-facing roles, or entirely different backgrounds. What matters most is that you're resourceful, quick to learn, and relentless about outcomes. If you thrive in fast-moving environments, love using AI and Notion to increase your leverage, and are excited to help shape the future of recruiting, we'd love to hear from you.
This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

Own recruiting for our highest-volume and early career roles across People, Legal, Finance, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Storytelling.
Build creative sourcing and outbound strategies that help us identify and engage exceptional talent, continuously experimenting with modern tools, channels, and AI-forward approaches to improve how we hire.
Contribute to redesigning how we evaluate candidates through building prompts, work trials, and creative experiments.
Partner closely with hiring managers to define hiring needs, calibrate on talent, run structured and rigorous interview processes, and make thoughtful hiring decisions.
Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from first outreach through close, helping candidates understand our mission, teams, and roles.
Learn the craft of recruiting from a high-performing team while developing into a trusted talent partner who influences how we attract, assess, and hire exceptional talent.

Proven track record of execution: 2+ years full-time experience in sales, customer success, business development, growth, or another role that required proactively creating opportunities rather than waiting for them.
Learner’s mindset: You actively seek feedback, adapt quickly, and are energized by tackling unfamiliar challenges.
AI Native: You're genuinely interested in AI technologies and eager to learn how to build with them. You see AI as a tool to automate workflows, reduce toil, and accelerate execution. Beyond personal use, you're excited to champion AI adoption across the Recruiting organization, helping teammates discover new ways to work smarter and more efficiently.
Thoughtful problem-solving: You approach problems holistically, starting with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can navigate ambiguity successfully, decompose complex problems into clean solutions, while also balancing the business impact of what you’re building.
Proactive communication and high agency: You own your work, communicating clearly about progress and blockers. You don't wait for instructions for every step but rather show initiative in identifying what needs to be done and driving projects forward. You ask questions when needed while independently finding solutions to problems.

About One Acre Fund
Founded in 2006, One Acre Fund equips 5.5 million smallholder farmers to make their farms more productive. Across nine countries that together are home to two-thirds of Africa's farmers, we provide high-quality farm supplies, tree seedlings, accessible credit, modern agronomic training, and a wide range of other agricultural services.

On average, this model enables any farmer to increase their income and assets on supported land by more than 35 percent, while permanently improving their resilience. This is all made possible by our team of 9,000+ full-time staff, drawn from diverse backgrounds and professions. To learn more, please see our Why Work Here blog post.
The Nigeria program, established in 2018, is headquartered in Minna, Niger state. We're currently serving over 100,000 unique farmers across the state via our inputs on credit 'Core' program, inputs on cash 'Retail' program, and have a free tree seedling distribution 'Agroforestry' program. To learn more about our work, look at our Nigeria program blog.

The Nigeria Recruitment Specialist will represent the Global Recruitment team in Minna, Nigeria. They will coordinate with the in-country HR team to fill high-volume openings for the country program as we expand and will manage additional Recruitment support if needed.

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences.

Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance.

Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Talent Specialist, US to join our People and Culture team. You’ll play a hands-on role in attracting, sourcing, and hiring world-class talent to support our business as we scale globally. You’ll work closely with hiring managers to understand their team needs, anticipate upcoming roles, and manage end-to-end recruitment processes that ensure we bring in exceptional people who align with our mission and values.
Reporting to the Talent Lead, GTM & Customer, you’ll focus on executing recruitment strategies, managing candidate pipelines, and delivering an outstanding candidate experience that reflects the calibre of our product and culture.
This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment, enjoys partnering closely with teams across the business, and wants to have a direct impact on how we grow.
Please note this role is based out of our Boulder office.

8+ years in talent acquisition/recruitment, ideally in high-growth or global tech environments and multiple disciplines (even better if you have extensive experience recruiting GTM roles, specifically sales and marketing roles!)
Proven experience building and scaling high-performing teams across multiple regions.
Strategic business partner who can zoom in and out: from exec-level reporting to day-to-day hiring excellence. Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, a true business partner to hiring teams.
Demonstrated success working in a fast-paced, high-volume hiring environment without compromising on the quality of talent we bring through the door.
You’ll have a deep knowledge of sourcing techniques and channels, and know what it takes to seek out the best talent globally.
Strong reporting and data skills; you’re able to track, analyse, and present key hiring metrics where needed.
Familiarity with employment laws, immigration requirements, and compliance across United States.
High emotional intelligence with excellent communication skills; a proactive, solutions-focused self-starter who thrives in ambiguity and takes strong ownership and accountability.

Build scalable recruitment practices and foundations, designing processes, tools, and ways of working that can flex across regions, functions, and increasing hiring volumes.
Upskill and enable hiring leaders, through coaching, training, and ongoing partnership to lift interviewing quality, assessment rigour, and hiring decision-making.
Support compensation benchmarking and market insights, contributing data and insights to inform fair, competitive, and consistent offers aligned to our compensation philosophy.
Partner on diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives, helping embed inclusive hiring practices and broaden access to talent across all roles.

Build and maintain strong candidate pipelines for current and future roles, proactively sourcing talent through multiple channels.

About Addi

Today, we serve over 3.6 million customers and partner with more than 55,000 merchants, making Addi Colombia’s fastest-growing marketplace.
With a state-of-the-art, technology-first approach, we provide banking solutions (deposits, payments, unsecured credit) and commerce services (e-commerce, marketing), bridging the financial gap for millions and redefining how people experience financial freedom.

As the country’s leading Buy Now, Pay Later provider, we have secured regulatory approval to operate as a bank, unlocking even greater opportunities for our customers. Our mission has earned the trust of world-class investors, including Andreessen Horowitz, Architect Capital, GIC, Goldman Sachs, Greycroft, Monashees, Notable Capital, Quona Capital, Union Square Ventures, Victory Park Capital, and more, who back our vision for the future. With their support, we are not just growing—we are transforming Latin America’s financial ecosystem and shaping the next generation to shop, pay, and bank in Colombia.
But what truly sets us apart is how we build. We are a conscious company, driven by deep experience in scaling technology, services and products, and we live by our values every day.

This is where you come in. Below, you’ll find what this role is all about—the impact you’ll drive, the challenges you’ll tackle, and what it takes to thrive at Addi. If you’re ready to be part of something big, keep reading.

Ensure your hired candidates are rated as high quality in their first 6-month review, proving a deep understanding of role requirements and a rigorous assessment process that selects for long-term success and cultural contribution.
Establish yourself as a trusted talent advisor to your primary hiring managers, consistently achieving high satisfaction on internal feedback by providing expert market insights, co-creating effective interview plans, and influencing decisions to ensure the best possible hire is made.

How This Role Makes a Difference
As a Patient Recruiter at Care Access , your mission is to connect patients with cutting-edge clinical trials. You will leverage your excellent communication skills, medical research knowledge, and technology proficiency to identify eligible candidates, educate them about the research, and facilitate their participation. Your commitment to outstanding patient care and your ability to adapt to evolving research protocols will drive the success of our clinical trials.

How You'll Make An Impact

Patient Recruitment: Act as the frontline connection between Care Access and potential study participants. This involves reaching out to individuals from our database and responding to inquiries from potential volunteers through various communication channels such as phone, email, or postal mail.

Patient Education: Educate prospective patients about the clinical research process, including the purpose of the study, potential benefits, and what to expect during study visits. Your ability to explain complex information in an accessible manner is essential.

Documentation: Maintain meticulous records of all patient interactions and communications. Accurate and comprehensive documentation is crucial to ensure a smooth patient journey through the clinical trial process.

Remote Pre-Screening: Conduct remote screening visits for specific studies. This involves using pre-screen checklist and assessing patient compatibility with study criteria and ensuring that all necessary assessments are completed accurately.

Appointment Scheduling: Schedule study visits with qualified subjects, considering their availability and study requirements. Timely reminders and follow-ups are essential to ensure patient commitment.

Collaborate closely with the Study Team and Clinical Research Coordinators (CRCs), serving as a bridge between patients and the research teams. Effective communication and coordination are critical for study success.
Utilize multiple platforms and software tools for managing patient data and scheduling. Proficiency in clinical trials databases, and standard office software is essential.
Review and comprehend active study protocols thoroughly. This understanding allows you to accurately convey study details to potential participants.
Maintain organized subject pre-screening logs to track patient progress, study enrollment, and compliance with study criteria.
Serve as a liaison between patients and both remote and local Clinical Research Coordinators (CRCs). Effective communication and coordination ensure a seamless patient experience.

The Expertise Required

Clinical Research Knowledge: You possess knowledge and the ability to apply ICH Good Clinical Practice (GCP) guidelines and other applicable regulatory standards. Your understanding of the clinical research process is essential for ensuring the integrity of our studies.
Medical and Research Terminology: An excellent working knowledge of medical and research terminology is crucial for effective communication with both patients and research teams. Your ability to convey complex information in an understandable manner is key.
Technology Proficiency: Comfortable working with data and technology, you can navigate various platforms for managing patient data and scheduling. Proficiency with clinical trials databases, and Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) is essential.
Time Management: Exceptional time management skills are part of your toolkit. You can effectively manage competing priorities, ensuring that patients receive timely and accurate information.
Team Collaboration Skills: You thrive in a collaborative environment and are capable of working effectively with other team members to accomplish mutual goals. Your positive and supportive attitude contributes to a cohesive team dynamic.
Communication Skills: Your friendly and outgoing personality, coupled with your strong verbal and written communication skills, allows you to maintain a positive attitude even under pressure. You excel at building rapport with patients and colleagues alike.
Adaptability: You are adaptable and flexible, able to navigate changing priorities and evolving research protocols. Your ability to maintain excellent customer service regardless of circumstances is highly valued.
Self-Motivation: You bring a high level of self-motivation and energy to your work. Your dedication to the mission of Care Access drives your commitment to excellence in patient care and support.

About the Team/Role Our Global Talent Acquisition team is at the forefront of attracting, sourcing, and hiring the exceptional talent that drives our business forward. We provide a best-in-class experience for candidates and hiring teams, balancing high performance with a collaborative culture.
We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to manage full life-cycle recruitment for our Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Operations requisitions.

In this role, you will act as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers, leveraging both ATS and CRM technology to source passive talent, build strong pipelines, and deliver a seamless hiring experience. This is an intermediate-level role ideal for an agile recruiter looking to broaden their impact and grow within a fast-paced global organization.
How you’ll make an impact

Manage the complete recruiting lifecycle for assigned sales and non-technical business functions—from intake call to offer acceptance.
Conduct intake meetings to define role requirements, align on candidate profiles, establish realistic timelines, and coach managers on effective interview techniques.
Screen resumes, conduct initial phone interviews, and evaluate candidates on functional competencies, sales aptitude (where applicable), and alignment with company culture.
Partner with HR and business leaders to construct competitive offer packages, navigate counter-offers, handle negotiations, and manage offer extensions through onboarding.
Utilize creative and proactive sourcing methodologies to engage top talent.
Build and nurture talent pools for sales and corporate roles using Phenom (CRM) to maintain a strong pipeline for future hiring needs.
Deliver a transparent, highly responsive experience for every applicant, keeping them informed throughout the pipeline.
Maintain real-time accuracy within our systems (Workday ATS & Phenom CRM) to support compliance and data-driven recruiting metrics.
Maintain strict adherence to EEO, ADA, affirmative action guidelines, and internal Talent Acquisition Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Identify bottlenecks in the recruitment funnel and recommend streamlined, efficient practices to reduce time-to-fill.

Experience you’ll bring

Minimum 2+ years of full life-cycle recruiting experience, ideally within a corporate environment or high-volume agency setting.
Demonstrated success recruiting for Sales (Account Executives, SDRs, Account Managers) and/or Non-Technical Business Operations (Marketing, Customer Service, Finance, HR).
Direct experience navigating Applicant Tracking Systems (Workday) and a recruitment CRM (Phenom) for candidate management and engagement..
Proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter, GSuite, and modern sourcing tools.
AI Affinity: Demonstrated comfort and foundational understanding of AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, AppScripts, Co-Pilot, Claude) and the critical thinking skills required to evaluate AI-generated input and responsibly inform decision-making. Exposure to AI-enabled platforms or workflow optimization tools is beneficial.

Key Competencies

Stakeholder Management: Ability to advise, influence, and build trust with cross-functional hiring managers.
Communication & Negotiation: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; adept at articulating company value propositions and negotiating offers.
Analytical Acumen: Comfortable using data to track funnel metrics, identify trends, and inform sourcing strategies.
Adaptability & Time Management: Ability to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously while reprioritizing on the fly in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

GTA Guiding Principles & Behaviors

Be Authentically Transparent: Build trust through open, honest communication with candidates and managers.
Seek and Hire the Best Talent: Keep bar-raising standards for every team we touch.
Innovate and Simplify: Find smarter, streamlined ways to work and reduce recruiter/candidate friction.
Take Ownership: Own the outcome from initial kickoff to successful candidate onboarding.
Learn and Be Curious: Continuously learn new sourcing strategies, business functions, and market trends.

s.h: How you will make an impact
s.t:
As a Technical Recruiter in Portugal, you'll be part of a global Talent Acquisition team and an ongoing Lisbon presence. You will hire across technical and non-technical disciplines - sourcing and engaging candidates, guiding them through our hiring process, and owning a candidate experience that reflects who we are as a company.
This role is ideal for someone early in their recruiting career who is genuinely curious about technology and who wants to learn how a high-performing engineering organization is built. You won't just execute a process: you'll be expected to understand the "why" behind every role, raise the bar on how we work, and build real, lasting relationships with the people we hire (and the ones we don't).
One of our core values is a growth mindset, and Iterable is a company where everyone can grow. If this role excites you, please apply, as we value applicants for the skills they bring beyond the job description. Note: Please kindly submit your resume in English. Thank you!

s.h: How you will make a difference
s.t:
Support and progressively own full-cycle recruitment across multiple roles as we grow our Lisbon team
Deliver a top-class candidate experience at every touchpoint - build genuine, lasting relationships, understand what drives each person, and make every interaction reflect who Iterable is
Partner with hiring managers to understand each role deeply - the tech stack, the team, the "why" - and use that knowledge to engage and evaluate candidates more effectively
Bring a technologist mindset to everything you do: actively explore AI tools, test new approaches, and find smarter ways to work across sourcing, outreach, and day-to-day recruiting
Support TA operations - maintaining templates, coordinating scheduling, and keeping our ATS up to date - ensuring the foundations are always in place for a seamless hiring process
Start building your presence in the local tech community - representing Iterable at events, growing your network, and nurturing candidate relationships over time

* Alliez proximité terrain et partenariat RH stratégique au quotidien.

## About Our Client ##
Notre client est un groupe international de premier plan évoluant dans un environnement haut de gamme, reconnu pour son savoir-faire, son exigence de qualité et son excellence opérationnelle. Ses activités en Suisse s'appuient sur des équipes multiculturelles et des sites de production combinant expertise technique, innovation et métiers à forte valeur ajoutée.
## Job Description ##
Rattaché(e) au Senior HR Business Partner, vous agissez comme partenaire RH de proximité auprès de plusieurs sites de production. Le poste implique une forte présence terrain et des déplacements quotidiens entre différents sites distants de plusieurs dizaines de kilomètres.
Vous accompagnez les collaborateurs tout au long de leur parcours, de l'intégration au développement, et prenez en charge les situations individuelles et collectives en garantissant le respect du droit du travail suisse, des politiques internes et des processus RH.
Vous identifiez les besoins actuels et futurs en compétences et contribuez au développement des collaborateurs et des apprentis. Vous participez à la mise en place de parcours de formation permettant d'assurer la transmission durable des savoir-faire et compétences critiques.
En collaboration avec le Senior HR Business Partner, vous contribuez aux revues de talents et de succession, notamment pour les fonctions clés. Vous participez au développement du vivier de talents et collaborez avec les équipes Talent Acquisition sur les recrutements stratégiques.
Vous pilotez les principaux processus RH de votre périmètre, notamment les revues de performance, les révisions salariales et les exercices budgétaires. Vous contribuez également à la planification des effectifs en fonction des capacités de production et anticipez les besoins sur les métiers critiques ou en tension.
Vous analysez les données RH telles que les effectifs, la mobilité, l'attrition ou l'absentéisme afin d'identifier les tendances, d'anticiper les besoins et de formuler des recommandations permettant d'éclairer les décisions du management.
En véritable partenaire du business, vous conseillez les directions de sites et les managers sur leurs enjeux humains et organisationnels. Vous les accompagnez dans leurs décisions RH, les coachez dans leur posture managériale et contribuez à maintenir un environnement de travail positif et engageant.
Enfin, vous participez aux évolutions organisationnelles et aux projets de transformation de votre périmètre, en veillant à l'alignement entre les besoins opérationnels et la stratégie globale de l'organisation.
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Vous êtes titulaire d'un Master ou d'un Brevet fédéral en Ressources Humaines et disposez d'une expérience confirmée en tant que HR Business Partner, idéalement acquise dans un environnement industriel ou de production au sein d'un groupe international.
* Vous êtes très mobile et prêt(e) à vous déplacer quotidiennement entre plusieurs sites de production, distants de plusieurs dizaines de kilomètres, afin d'assurer une présence régulière et une réelle proximité avec les équipes terrain.
* Vous possédez un excellent sens du business et savez transformer les enjeux opérationnels en solutions RH pragmatiques et à forte valeur ajoutée. À l'aise avec les données RH et les indicateurs liés aux effectifs, vous les utilisez pour soutenir la prise de décision.
* Partenaire crédible et orienté(e) solutions, vous savez conseiller, challenger et influencer des interlocuteurs de différents niveaux hiérarchiques. Vous êtes capable d'aller au-delà de l'application des processus afin de proposer des réponses adaptées aux besoins de l'organisation.
* Vous avez un réel intérêt pour le développement des personnes, la gestion des talents et la transmission des savoir-faire. Votre excellent relationnel, votre écoute active et votre intelligence situationnelle vous permettent de créer rapidement des relations de confiance.
* Vous maîtrisez le droit du travail suisse ainsi que les principaux processus RH, notamment le recrutement, la gestion de la performance et la rémunération.
* Vous parlez couramment français, possédez un bon niveau d'anglais et disposez d'excellentes capacités rédactionnelles. Un permis de conduire ainsi qu'une mobilité régulière entre différents sites de production sont nécessaires.
## What's on Offer ##
Vous rejoignez un environnement international, multiculturel et stimulant, dans une fonction RH stratégique bénéficiant d'une forte proximité avec les opérations et les équipes de production. Ce rôle multisite offre une grande diversité d'interlocuteurs et de problématiques, avec une présence terrain importante.
Vous travaillerez en binôme avec un(e) Senior HR Business Partner expérimenté(e), qui vous accompagnera dans votre montée en compétences et dans la gestion des sujets RH. Cette configuration est particulièrement adaptée à un profil HRBP encore junior souhaitant gagner progressivement en autonomie et en responsabilités, tout en continuant à apprendre au quotidien auprès d'un profil senior.
Le package comprend notamment des conditions de prévoyance attractives, des participations à certains frais, ainsi qu'une offre étendue de formations. Selon l'éligibilité et les contraintes liées à la présence sur les différents sites, une organisation de travail flexible peut également être proposée.

bénévolat neuchâtel (ci-après bn) est l’association faîtière cantonale regroupant des associations, fondations et autres organisations à but non lucratif qui recourent au bénévolat dans le canton de Neuchâtel.

A ce titre, bn est mandaté par l’Etat pour délivrer des prestations d’information, de conseil et d’orientation, pour faciliter les liens entre la population neuchâteloise, les associations, les collectivités publiques, les professionnel-le-s et les entreprises dans le but de promouvoir et de valoriser le bénévolat.

Ainsi, bn est l’interlocuteur privilégié des acteurs associatifs et bénévoles ainsi que des autorités publiques dans le canton de Neuchâtel en matière de bénévolat.

Interlocuteur-trice privilégié-e de l'équipe, du Bureau, du Comité, des membres de l’association, des partenaires institutionnels, vous occupez une fonction centrale dans le pilotage de l'organisation et contribuez activement à la préparation des décisions et assurez leur mise en oeuvre.
Dans le cadre des orientations définies par le Comité, vous assumez notamment les responsabilités suivantes :
Pilotage opérationnel et évolution de l’organisation
Vous assurez le pilotage des activités de bn, coordonnez la mise en oeuvre de ses prestations et projets et veillez à l’atteinte des objectifs fixés. Vous contribuez à faire évoluer l’organisation, ses processus et ses modes de fonctionnement afin de répondre aux enjeux et aux besoins de l’association.
Management et ressources humaines
Vous encadrez l’équipe, coordonnez son activité et favorisez un cadre de travail mobilisateur et clairement collaboratif. Vous accompagnez le développement des compétences et les évolutions organisationnelles et conduisez les processus RH, notamment en matière de recrutement, d’évaluation et de gestion du personnel.
Gestion financière, administrative et qualité
Vous garantissez une gestion rigoureuse des ressources de l’association, élaborez le budget, en assurez le suivi et établissez les comptes annuels. Vous veillez au respect des mandats confiés à bn, des exigences administratives et des dispositions légales, réglementaires et statutaires applicables, ainsi qu’à la qualité des prestations délivrées.
Gouvernance et aide à la décision
Vous préparez les séances du Bureau et du Comité avec la Présidence, fournissez les informations et analyses nécessaires à la prise de décision et assurez le suivi des décisions prises et leur mise en oeuvre. Vous favorisez une articulation claire et constructive entre les instances de gouvernance et le fonctionnement opérationnel de l’association.
Développement des prestations, partenariats et représentation
Vous organisez et assurez le bon déroulement des formations dispensées par bn. Vous représentez bn et développez des relations de confiance avec les autorités cantonales et communales, les membres, les partenaires institutionnels et les associations. Vous identifiez les évolutions et opportunités liées au bénévolat et proposez les adaptations nécessaires au développement des prestations de bn.

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en gestion des ressources humaines, comprenant la conduite d’une équipe, le recrutement, l’accompagnement et le développement des compétences. Vous savez susciter l’adhésion en favorisant l’intelligence collective.

Vous comprenez les enjeux propres aux environnements associatifs, parapublics et institutionnels neuchâtelois. A l’aise dans un rôle de représentation, vous savez collaborer avec des instances de gouvernance, des autorités et des partenaires aux intérêts variés.
Vous alliez sens de la communication orale et écrite et aisance relationnelle. Vous disposez également d’excellentes capacités d’analyse et d’organisation. Votre posture professionnelle se caractérise par l’écoute, l’autonomie et le sens de la coopération.

En tant que Généraliste RH, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la gestion administrative RH pour l'ensemble des sites en Suisse alémanique et en Suisse romande. Véritable interlocuteur de confiance pour les collaborateurs et les managers, vous veillez à la qualité des processus RH, à la fiabilité des données et au respect des exigences légales et internes.
Vous contribuez également à l'amélioration continue des pratiques RH et à une collaboration efficace entre les différentes fonctions RH et les parties prenantes de l'entreprise.
Vos principales responsabilités
Administration RH : assurer la gestion et la mise à jour des dossiers collaborateurs, contrats, avenants, certificats de travail et données RH, en garantissant leur exactitude et leur conformité.
Onboarding \& Offboarding : coordonner les processus d'entrée et de sortie de A à Z, notamment les formalités contractuelles, autorisations de travail, mises à jour dans les systèmes RH et éléments nécessaires à la paie.
Administration Payroll : assurer la préparation et le suivi des données nécessaires à la paie, notamment les absences, congés, télétravail, congés sans solde et éléments liés aux départs, dans le respect des délais.
Employee Relations : accompagner les collaborateurs et managers sur les questions administratives et liées à leur parcours professionnel, en apportant des réponses fiables, professionnelles et adaptées.
Support aux équipes RH : collaborer étroitement avec les HR Business Partners, Payroll et l'ensemble de l'équipe RH afin d'assurer un service efficace et homogène sur l'ensemble des sites.
Amélioration continue : identifier les opportunités d'optimisation, contribuer à la standardisation des processus et promouvoir les bonnes pratiques au sein de l'organisation.
Conformité \& confidentialité : veiller au respect des exigences légales suisses, des procédures internes et des standards de protection des données, avec un haut niveau de discrétion et de rigueur.

Human Resources designs, implements and delivers human resource programs and policies, including recruitment, talent management, diversity and inclusion, compensation and benefits, among others. Drive the identification, engagement, and alignment of top-tier talent across corporate functions, with a primary focus on leadership hiring (Manager level through VP/Executive). In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to business leaders and recruiting partners, delivering a high-touch, consultative sourcing experience.
We are looking for a true utility player: someone adaptable, highly versatile, and ready to pivot across functional areas, search levels, and talent initiatives as business priorities evolve. You will build robust, diverse pipelines that ensure we consistently raise the bar and scale leadership across the organization with intention.

As a Corporate Sourcer supporting Leadership Hiring, you will partner directly with hiring managers, talent acquisition teams, and HR business partners to design and execute targeted search strategies. You will combine market intelligence, proactive outreach, and talent mapping to engage high-impact leaders across Manager, Director, and VP tiers.

s.h: Additionally, the Corporate Sourcer is responsible for
s.t:
Search Strategy & Market Mapping: Build and execute comprehensive sourcing strategies to identify, map, and engage high-caliber talent across various corporate functions (e.g., HR, Finance, Legal, Marketing, Operations).
Cross-Functional Versatility: Act as a flexible "utility player" across the TA team, comfortably shifting focus across different business areas, candidate levels, and emergent search priorities without missing a beat.
Pipeline Development & Diversity: Proactively cultivate deep, diverse talent networks to support current and future leadership needs while advancing our commitment to a diverse global workforce.
Candidate Engagement & Relationship Building: Gain the trust of passive prospective candidates, articulate our value proposition, and successfully convert them into active candidates across Manager, Director, and Executive levels.
Calibration & Intelligence: Partner with hiring managers and recruiters to calibrate candidate profiles, share market research, and provide insights on industry talent trends.

Data & Search Progress: Track and leverage sourcing metrics, market feedback, and candidate data to refine sourcing tactics and present updates during search reviews.
Knowledge Sharing: Continually contribute to the team’s knowledge base by sharing competitive landscape mapping, market conditions, and target company research.

Utility Player Mindset: High adaptability and comfort with ambiguity; ability to pivot seamlessly between different corporate functions, role types, and evolving business needs.

Organization & Agility: Strong prioritization skills to manage multiple leadership searches simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
Technical & Sourcing Tools: Proficiency with modern sourcing tools, CRM platforms, ATS systems, and talent intelligence platforms.

Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Recruiting team builds Stripe’s culture by connecting exceptional talent with our highest-impact business needs. We bring Stripe’s operating principles to life through thoughtful, consistent hiring practices, a high-quality candidate experience, and data-informed partnership with the business.

Stripe is looking for a consultative, creative recruiter to support critical Core Business functions. You will partner with senior leaders who shape Stripe’s financial strategy, external narrative, long-term growth, and company-wide decision-making.
This is a high-impact portfolio with varied talent markets, senior stakeholders, and roles where the quality of each hire can influence how Stripe operates and grows. You will own full-cycle recruiting, advise leaders on hiring strategy and market conditions, and build trusted relationships with candidates and hiring teams.

Partner with senior leaders to understand business priorities, define hiring plans, and develop recruiting strategies that support headcount goals.
Own the full recruiting lifecycle, from intake and sourcing through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff.
Advise hiring teams on talent-market conditions, candidate availability, competitive dynamics, and hiring approaches for specialized and senior roles.
Develop and execute sourcing strategies that build broad, qualified candidate pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Build strong candidate relationships and deliver a thoughtful, timely candidate experience throughout the process.
Use recruiting data to track progress, identify risks and opportunities, and provide clear updates to business leaders.
Improve recruiting processes where needed, testing practical changes that help hiring teams move with clarity and consistency.
Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Finance, People Operations, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal, to support a smooth offer and onboarding experience.
Uphold structured, competency-based hiring practices and help hiring teams assess candidates against the requirements of each role.

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including in-house recruiting experience.

## Firmenbeschreibung ##
Seit nahezu 40 Jahren sind wir erfolgreich als Stellenvermittler unterwegs. Als Familien Unternehmen verbinden wir bewährte Werte mit modernen Arbeitsweisen, innovativen Lösungen und einem starken Teamgeist. Wir sind regional verwurzelt und schweizweit vernetzt.

Mit 28 Filialen in der Schweiz und in Liechtenstein sind wir nah bei unseren Kunden und gleichzeitig Teil eines starken nationalen Netzwerks. Was uns auszeichnet? Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein respektvolles Miteinander und Menschen, die gemeinsam etwas bewegen wollen. Bei uns zählt nicht nur die Erfahrung, sondern auch frische Ideen.

Deshalb bieten wir die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, sich weiterzuentwickeln und aktiv zum Erfolg des Unternehmens beizutragen. Dank unserer langjährigen Erfahrung, unserer starken Teams und unseres konsequenten Qualitätsanspruchs gehören wir heute zu den führenden Unternehmen unserer Branche.

Werde ein Teil unserer wachsenden und motivierten Familie, dich erwartet ein Umfeld, indem kein Tag wie der andere ist und indem du wirklich etwas bewegen kannst.
## Stellenbeschreibung ##
In der abwechslungsreichen Rolle als Personalberater: in bringst du Menschen und Unternehmen erfolgreich zusammen.
* Du erstellst ansprechende Stelleninserate, führst spannende Gespräche mit Kandidaten und findest für sie passende Arbeitsstellen.
* Gleichzeitig baust du dir dein eigenes Kundenportfolio auf, gewinnt aktiv neue Unternehmen in der Region und entwickelst bestehende Beziehungen langfristig weiter.
* Du berätst Kunden kompetent bei ihren Personalbedürfnissen und bringst die richtigen Kandidaten mit den passenden Unternehmen zusammen.
* Du übernimmst den gesamten Recruiting Prozess von der Suche nach passenden Fachkräften über Interviews bis hin zu erfolgreicher Vermittlung.
* Als zentrale Ansprechperson stehst du sowohl den Kunden als auch den Mitarbeitenden bei personalrelevanten Fragen zur Seite.
* Auch ausserhalb des Büros bist du aktiv. Du repräsentierst unser Unternehmen, du bringst eigene Ideen ein und organisierst Kunden- und Mitarbeiterveranstaltungen.

About Mosaic Health
Mosaic Health is dedicated to transforming healthcare through innovative, patient-centered care models that improve outcomes and access. We are building a high-performing team of mission-driven professionals who are passionate about making healthcare better for patients, providers, and communities.

Mosaic Health is seeking an experienced and relationship-driven Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. Reporting to the Manager, Talent Acquisition, this role will be responsible for managing full-cycle recruiting across a variety of business functions, partnering closely with hiring managers to identify, attract, and hire top talent.
The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, data-driven, and passionate about delivering an exceptional candidate and hiring manager experience. This individual will play a critical role in supporting Mosaic Health's continued growth by developing effective sourcing strategies, managing candidate pipelines, and serving as a trusted talent advisor throughout the hiring process.

Full-Cycle Recruitment
Manage the end-to-end recruitment process from intake through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff.
Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, role requirements, and ideal candidate profiles.
Develop and execute recruiting strategies to attract qualified and diverse talent.
Conduct candidate sourcing through job boards, professional networks, referrals, social media, and direct outreach.
Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate interviews to assess qualifications, experience, and cultural alignment.
Coordinate and facilitate interview processes, ensuring a seamless experience for candidates and interview teams.
Manage offer development and negotiation in partnership with hiring managers and Human Resources.

Talent Partnership & Consultation
Serve as a strategic advisor to hiring managers on recruiting best practices, market trends, and talent availability.
Provide guidance on interview techniques, candidate evaluation, and hiring decisions.
Build strong relationships with business leaders and stakeholders across the organization.
Ensure consistency and compliance throughout the hiring process.
Candidate Experience
Deliver a high-quality, professional, and engaging experience for all candidates.
Maintain timely communication with candidates throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
Promote Mosaic Health's employer brand and value proposition in all candidate interactions.
Talent Pipeline Development
Build and maintain proactive talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Leverage market research and sourcing tools to identify top talent.
Develop and maintain relationships with passive candidates and industry professionals.
Recruiting Operations & Reporting
Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting activity within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
Track and report on recruiting metrics, including time-to-fill, pipeline health, and source effectiveness.
Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.
Support continuous improvement initiatives within the Talent Acquisition function.

Required
Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience.
3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, preferably in healthcare, corporate, technology, or high-growth environments.
Proven experience sourcing and recruiting for a variety of professional-level roles.
Strong interviewing, candidate assessment, and relationship-building skills.
Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter.
Excellent communication, organizational, and project management skills.
Ability to manage multiple requisitions and competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering an exceptional candidate experience.

Experience recruiting within healthcare, value-based care, health technology, or related industries.
Experience supporting remote and geographically dispersed teams.
Knowledge of employment law and recruiting compliance requirements.
Experience utilizing recruiting analytics and workforce planning data to inform hiring strategies.

Consultative and collaborative approach

Adaptability and problem-solving

s.h: BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
s.t:
At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.
Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you .
We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.
This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

As a SpaceX recruiter, you will run a full desk with a variety of duties and responsibilities focused on the sourcing, screening, interviewing, and onboarding of top talent candidates to fill mission critical positions (pun intended).

In many cases, you are candidates’ first encounter with SpaceX and it is your job to represent the company with professionalism, pride, and enthusiasm. We work in teams and focus on collaboration yet require a high degree of autonomy.

So, while you are not expected to simply go it alone, you are expected to show initiative, take responsibility, and run with tasks to completion.
Your day-to-day routine will change often as hiring priorities shift, but there is a basic set of activities you can expect to run with daily, including, but not limited to:
Meet with your client groups to discuss headcount, new requisitions, hiring strategy, and/or interview feedback – you truly act as a partner to your clients and not merely as an order taker
Screen candidates who apply to requisitions – as the SpaceX name brand grows, our job postings continue to fill up with stellar candidates
Source candidates – often the best candidates are the ones not actively looking
Discuss candidates you have screened with your client groups and recommend top candidates for interviews
Give tours to candidates before their onsite
Attend interviews alongside your client groups to act as another set of eyes and ears in evaluating candidates
Once candidates are approved for hire, you will begin the offer process including initiating background checks, negotiating offer packages and extending offer letters
Some days you will have multiple candidates coming onsite for interviews and you will spend that time giving tours and coordinating the candidate experience. Other days, you will need to fill your candidate pipeline and will spend the majority of the day screening/sourcing candidates. No day is the same here and the pace moves fast, but ultimately your job is to effectively attract, organize, and manage the flow of the country’s most talented individuals.
Bachelor’s degree and 1+ years of recruiting experience; OR associate degree and 2+ years of experience; OR 3+ years of professional experience as a recruiter in lieu of a degree

2+ years of technical recruiting experience
Experience with in-house recruiting
Experience with high volume recruiting
Experience recruiting electrical, mechanical and aerospace engineers
Experience recruiting skilled labor
Strong tenure with demonstrated success in recruiting roles
Full life cycle recruiting experience, from sourcing to closing
Comfort with reviewing, evaluating and reporting on recruiting data
Ability to distinguish between the top 50% and the top 5% of talent within their respective fields
Demonstrated expertise in non-standard recruiting methods: cold calling candidates and companies, organizing and executing ad hoc networking events, identifying industry experts and finding unique methods to engage with them, creating unique targeted sourcing campaigns, etc.
Comfortable interfacing directly with hiring managers including director and VP level technical leaders
Ability to build strong relationships with both hiring managers and candidates
Ability to accurately present but not oversell candidates to client groups; influence decisions by acting as the subject matter expert on talent but avoid dictating client decisions
Ability to multi-task and operate with little direction while still being an active team member

Available to work extended hours and weekends as needed
This position is based in Starbase, TX (Brownsville area), and requires being onsite full-time – hybrid and remote work will not be considered

Help us build a stronger company. Every day.
